metadata.datasource: Measured off Fujifilm data sheet AF3-0258E (20.02), NEOPAN 100 ACROS II (135), Microfine, small tank, 10 min at 20 C: Fujifilm's time for EI 100 in its own developer, in which the sheet measures its RMS granularity and resolving power too. Characteristic curve laid on agx's axis with the ISO speed point (0.10 over base + fog) 1.007 decades below mid-grey, box speed ISO 100; base + fog 0.125. Continued at its final gradient for 0.8 decades past the last plotted exposure. Spectral sensitivity: Fujifilm's spectrogram to daylight (5400K), divided by CIE daylight at 5400 K, as Neopan 1600's: it gives filter factors of 1.6x yellow (Wratten 8), 2.6x orange (No. 22) and 4.2x red (No. 25) in daylight, where the sheet's table, which repeats Neopan 1600's, says 2, 4 (No. 21) and 8. One silver layer, carried as three identical channels.
